name: Phone tester builds
author: wizard
description: Your phones are offered the newest WizardOS phone tester build (the GitHub prerelease each phone merge publishes) instead of waiting for it to become public. The App Manager (wam/phone_sync.py) checks it exactly like a public release: the real WizardOS signing key, sha256, size and the version cap. Nothing on screen changes; the phone's own update prompt offers the newer build.
